usage: tr retrieval query [-h] --ticker TICKER --as-of AS_OF [-k K]
                          [--index INDEX]
                          [--retriever {bm25,dense,hybrid,hybrid+rerank}]
                          text

positional arguments:
  text

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ticker TICKER
  --as-of AS_OF         the session (YYYY-MM-DD) whose close is the cutoff
  -k K                  chunks to return (default 10)
  --index INDEX         index digest or prefix (default: the newest)
  --retriever {bm25,dense,hybrid,hybrid+rerank}
                        (default bm25)
